assistant: We are receiving instruction from three different instructors under the course titled Art Studio, but this evaluation can only be made for our instructor Elvan Serin. I fully stand behind the scores I have given for both Elvan Serin and Ercan Sağlam, and I have the utmost respect for their teaching. However, I do not feel the same way about Beata. Beata has not been successful in sparking curiosity or interest in the course, and she does not give students the freedom to explore and find themselves creatively. Instead, she provides a purely traditional form of education. As Fine Arts students, we are exposed to a wide variety of courses from different disciplines, and we aim to integrate those experiences into our own artistic practice. Unfortunately, I believe Beata limits our creative thinking and makes us feel even more restricted in our journey to discover our own path. While our other instructors have taken our psychological well-being into consideration throughout the semester, I feel that Beata has overlooked this aspect. This situation affects my motivation. It needs to be considered.
